candidate_u: the global G2/SU3 stabilizer section; twistor orientation is compatible only after an explicit bundle map

globalization.bulk_extension: extension away from M4 is conditional on extending the SU3 reduction; the M4 dimension argument alone does not prove it
globalization.bundle: E_7=P_G2 x_7 R^7 over the selected M4 boundary
globalization.conjugate_bundle: complex conjugation exchanges E_10 and E_01
globalization.existence: a nowhere-zero section exists on the declared M4 base
globalization.obstruction_on_M4: zero because H^7(M4)=0 for a four-manifold
globalization.section_meaning: a unit section u reduces P_G2 to its SU3 stabilizer
globalization.selection: the frozen action does not dynamically choose one section
globalization.transition_functions: after reduction they lie in SU3 and obey J_(g u)(g v)=g J_u(v), so Pi_10 and Pi_01 patch covariantly

orientation_reversal: u->-u exchanges Pi_10 and Pi_01; scalar-wall sign alone does not
